errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.conflict: That conflicts with the current state. Refresh and retry.

validation.pan: Enter a valid PAN, for example ABCDE1234F.
validation.ifsc: Enter a valid IFSC code, for example SBIN0001234.
validation.password: Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
validation.passwordsDiffer: The new password must be different from the current one.
validation.totpCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

twoFactor.challengeBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.body: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: This page needs a permission your account does not have.

partStatus.Returning: Could not be delivered - going back

shipping.missingPackages: No package recorded for {{skus}}. Weigh and measure the box.
shipping.suggested: Worked out from the products. Correct it if the box you used differs.

sellerPortal.registerIntro: Create an account first. Then tell us about your shop, and we will review it.
sellerPortal.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
sellerPortal.applyIntro: Tell us about your shop. We review every application before a shop can sell.
sellerPortal.pendingNote: We will get back to you soon. You cannot edit it while it is in review.
sellerPortal.kycNote: Your legal and bank details cannot be changed after approval without contacting support.
sellerPortal.liveLocked: This listing is live. To change its wording or category, contact a moderator. Price, stock and package can be changed below.
sellerPortal.packageNote: One unit, packed. Couriers price on this, so weigh the packed box.
sellerPortal.pickupOwn: Couriers collect from your pickup location "{{name}}".
sellerPortal.pickupWarehouse: You ship from the platform warehouse, "{{name}}".
sellerPortal.pickupHelp: To collect from your own address, register it as a pickup location in Shiprocket and enter its name here exactly.

sale.title: Sale
sale.note: A lower price for a while. You are paid on the sale price. Buyers see the regular price struck through beside it.
sale.startsHint: Leave the start empty to begin now. The sale runs to the end of its last day.

settlements.earningsNote: You are paid for a parcel once the buyer's return window has closed. Payouts are made every Monday to your bank account.
settlements.awaitingCash: Waiting for the courier to pay over the cash

adjustment.CouponRevoked: coupon discount given back to you

returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: Buyers asking to send delivered parcels back. The refund falls due when the parcel is back with the seller.
returns.requestTitle: The buyer wants to return this parcel
returns.rejectNote: Why are you refusing? The buyer sees this.
returns.approvedToast: Return accepted. A courier pickup is being booked.
returns.awaitingPickup: Return accepted. The parcel is on its way back.
returns.pickupFailed: The return pickup is not booked yet: {{error}}
returns.inspectBody: Check it. If it can be sold again, its stock goes back on sale.
returns.good: Good - put it back on sale

inspectedAs.Good: Returned and put back on sale.

reviews.sellerSubtitle: What buyers say about your products. Their words and photos appear here once our staff approve them.
reviews.waitingForApproval: The buyer's words are waiting for our approval.
reviews.notPublished: The buyer's words were not approved.
reviews.replyHint: Shown under the review on your product page. Keep it polite: our staff can hide replies.
reviews.replyHidden: Our staff have hidden this reply from the storefront.

coupons.sellerSubtitle: Codes for money off your products, and platform campaigns you can join. Both come out of what you are paid.
coupons.youPay: You pay for the discount: you are paid on the discounted price.
coupons.campaignsSubtitle: Join one and its discount applies to your products while you are in it. You pay for it, as with your own coupons.
coupons.noCampaigns: No campaigns to join right now.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: People who work in your seller portal with their own sign-in. Only you manage the team, see earnings and change the shop’s details.

roleHelp.Manager: Products, stock, orders, dispatch, coupons and reviews.

team.addHint: They register on the seller portal first, then you add them by that email. Their access starts the next time they sign in.
team.none: No one else is on your team yet.
